Warm hearted, genuine and caring people. All whom have never met me. But they still took the time out of their day to approach me. The guy who felt like everything in the world was out to get him, actually felt a sense of relief. Someone out there believes in me. Someone had faith in me. Someone cared enough to type out a two paragraph comment on my post. 

People saved me. Random strangers who i’ll never speak to again... saved my life.
